workload_identities._comment: Lab 29 policy: identity-type planner and workload identity audit. The engine reads only this section.

action_definitions.DISABLE_UNUSED: Disable the identity (and later delete it) because nothing has signed in with it recently.
action_definitions.REDUCE_SCOPE: Replace the broad privileged role with a least-privilege role at resource-group or resource scope.
action_definitions.REPLACE_SECRET_WITH_FEDERATION: Add a federated identity credential for the external platform, then delete the client secret.
action_definitions.ROTATE: Issue a new credential (preferably a certificate), update the workload, then remove the old one.
action_definitions.ASSIGN_OWNER: Name at least one accountable human owner for the application.
action_definitions.OK: No finding: keep the identity and review it at the next audit.

concepts.managed identity: An identity for an Azure resource whose credentials Azure creates, stores and rotates, so the code never handles a secret.
concepts.system-assigned managed identity: A managed identity created on one Azure resource that is deleted automatically when that resource is deleted.
concepts.user-assigned managed identity: A managed identity created as its own Azure resource that can be attached to several resources and outlives any one of them.
concepts.service principal: The local representation of an application in a Microsoft Entra tenant that receives role assignments and signs in as the app.
concepts.app registration: The global definition of an application (its application ID and credentials) from which service principals are created.
concepts.workload identity federation: Trust between an app and an external OpenID Connect issuer so the workload swaps its own platform token for an Entra token with no stored secret.
concepts.client secret: A password-like string stored for an application; it can leak, it expires and someone must rotate it.
concepts.eligible assignment: A Privileged Identity Management role assignment that must be activated, for a limited time, before it grants any permission.
